[data-ground="dark"] {
  --neon-strength: 1;
  --neon-core: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent) 92%, white);
  --neon-halo: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent) calc(46% * var(--neon-strength)), transparent);
  --neon-far: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent) calc(16% * var(--neon-strength)), transparent);
  --lightningcss-light: ;
  --lightningcss-dark: initial;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

[data-ground="dark"] .u-rule {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-line) 78%, var(--c-accent));
}

[data-ground="dark"] .text-accent, [data-ground="dark"] [data-neon="text"] {
  color: var(--neon-core);
  text-shadow: 0 0 calc(6px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-halo),
    0 0 calc(22px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-far);
}

[data-ground="dark"] .bg-accent, [data-ground="dark"] [data-neon="line"] {
  box-shadow: 0 0 calc(7px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-halo),
    0 0 calc(24px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-far);
}

[data-ground="dark"] [data-scroll-progress] {
  box-shadow: 0 0 calc(8px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-halo),
    0 0 calc(26px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-far);
}

[data-ground="dark"] :focus-visible {
  outline-color: var(--neon-core);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--neon-halo),
    0 0 calc(14px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-far);
}

[data-ground="dark"] [data-neon="frame"] {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent) 12%, transparent),
    0 24px 70px -30px #000000e6;
}

[data-ground="dark"] [data-cursor-dot] {
  box-shadow: 0 0 calc(10px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-halo),
    0 0 calc(30px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-far);
}

[data-ground="dark"] a[data-neon="link"]:hover, [data-ground="dark"] button[data-neon="link"]:hover {
  color: var(--neon-core);
  text-shadow: 0 0 calc(8px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-halo),
    0 0 calc(26px * var(--neon-strength)) var(--neon-far);
  transition: color .42s var(--ease-editorial, ease),
    text-shadow .42s var(--ease-editorial, ease);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-ground="dark"] a[data-neon="link"]:hover, [data-ground="dark"] button[data-neon="link"]:hover {
    transition: none;
  }
}

@media (forced-colors: active) {
  [data-ground="dark"] .text-accent, [data-ground="dark"] [data-neon="text"], [data-ground="dark"] .bg-accent, [data-ground="dark"] [data-neon="line"], [data-ground="dark"] [data-scroll-progress], [data-ground="dark"] [data-neon="frame"], [data-ground="dark"] [data-cursor-dot] {
    text-shadow: none;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
}
